note: Regional park jointly owned by Meeker and Stearns Counties on the southwest shore of Lake Koronis; the wooded campground lies across County Road 20 from the beach, picnic area and boat landing, a short walk from the lake. --Claude
summary: Meeker County page + 3/2026 brochure read: $45+tax electric confirmed (tent $25); 40 sites (32 electric, 4 of them seasonal; 8 tent) + 3 cabins; no water/sewer at sites; showers/flush/dump; May 1 - Sep 30; books online (Peek) or by phone. Not waterfront confirmed. Pin moves ~450 m to the campground.

Seasonal share: 4 of 32 electric sites (A, 23-25) are seasonal; nightly sites dominate, so the long-stay tests don't bite.
